newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - fuel oil firms $2, rest weak.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel oil firms $2, rest weak.

text.p: NWE oil products weakened on Friday, except fuel oil barges which were about $2 a tonne higher to draw in line with swaps, dealers said.

High sulphur fuel oil barges $83.00 and $83.50 fob ARA. One major bought some 10,000 tonnes. Traders said bunker market demand improved from midweek lows, but attributed the gains to the strength of May swaps. They said there were no signs of supply tightness.
"Looking at the (high sulphur) cargoes, barges should be much lower. It seems to be related to swaps," one trader said.
One eurograde barge traded at $197 fob Rotterdam for first half May delivery, a price believed to be repeatable. May swaps came down by around $1 to $197 fob ARA.

Heating oil barges were around $2 a tonne weaker as IPE May gas oil futures gave way. The physical market remained quiet. Sellers were reluctant to offer into a vacuum. Offers were believed to be broadly unchanged at IPE May +75 cents/+$1 fob Rotterdam.
"A lot of people are away. There's no trade buying and both buyers and sellers are stubborn," one trader said.
